assets.prompt: Plain photograph of a historical reenactment costume worn by a real person, muted natural colours, real wear, dirt and mended cloth, no fantasy polish, no idealised face, no smile, no dramatic lighting, no text, no watermark, no signature. A lean unshaven man in his thirties dressed as a highway bandit: a dark hooded wool cloak thrown back over the shoulders, a stained quilted gambeson under a scuffed leather jerkin, patched wool hose, worn leather boots, a plain belt with a sheathed knife and a short sword in a scabbard at the left hip, a hard wary face. Full body, standing in a relaxed A-pose with the arms held slightly away from the body, straight front view facing the camera squarely, feet fully visible, nothing cropped, single subject centred, neutral mid-grey background, flat even lighting with no shadow on the background.
